having_IPhaving_IP_Address: Whether the URL host uses an IP address instead of a domain name.
URLURL_Length: A categorical bin for URL length; not a character count.
Shortining_Service: Whether the address uses a URL-shortening service, according to the historical extractor.
having_At_Symbol: Presence of an @ symbol in the URL.
double_slash_redirecting: Location of an additional double slash in the URL; this flag does not prove a redirect occurs.
Prefix_Suffix: Hyphen-separated text in the domain name.
having_Sub_Domain: Categorized subdomain depth using the source's domain parsing rules.
SSLfinal_State: Historical HTTPS/certificate trust and age category; requires more than URL text.
Favicon: Whether the page favicon is sourced from another domain.
port: Historical service-port assessment requiring network information.
HTTPS_token: Use of the text HTTPS inside the domain, distinct from the URL protocol.
Request_URL: Category for external resources requested by a page.
URL_of_Anchor: Category describing page anchor destinations and unsafe or external anchors.
Links_in_tags: External links in page metadata, script and link tags.
Abnormal_URL: Relationship between the host and domain registration identity.
on_mouseover: Page behavior that changes the displayed destination on hover.
RightClick: Whether page scripts disable right-click interaction.
Iframe: Use of iframe-based page behavior in the historical extractor.
DNSRecord: Availability of a historical DNS record.
web_traffic: Historical traffic/popularity category; not a current popularity measurement.
Links_pointing_to_page: Category for incoming links to the page.
